messages:
liz: Quick FYI — repro where the Node sampleapp drops the request-id on retries when OpenTelemetry hooks are enabled. Repro + notes below.

kevin: :eyes: thanks for the heads-up. Can you paste the tiny repro here?

liz: Sure — minimal repro: 
```
// sampleapp.js
const reqId = generate();
fetch('/api', { headers: { 'x-request-id': reqId } });
// our retry middleware triggers a second attempt, but header is missing on retry
```
With otel hooks on we also run a redaction hook on response headers. Looks like ordering: retry -> send but our reqid attach runs after otel hook init in some boot paths.

sam: Is this only Node or do we expect python/sdk parity?

liz: I verified in Node 18 using the latest dev SDK build. Python might be affected in apps that init telemetry early/late — haven't repro'd yet.

mika: Sounds like an init-order race. We register the otel hook during SDK init which can run before app-level middleware that assigns x-request-id. If redaction runs before reqid is attached it strips fields differently.

kevin: Short-term workaround: ensure request-id is added at top of middleware chain (earlier) or set REDACT_HEADERS=false for onboarding devs. Not ideal.

liz: Agreed not ideal (PII risk). Proposed fix: move request-id assignment into the transport layer so it's always present before any otel hook/redactor runs, plus add test coverage. I filed INF-4297 with details.

sam: Can you add an integration test in sampleapp CI that simulates a retry and asserts x-request-id persists? That would prevent regressions.

liz: Yep will add a test and a small instrumenting trace to show timestamps for (1) reqid generation, (2) retry decision, (3) otel redaction. Should make ordering explicit.

ops-bot: deploy: sampleapp/onboarding fix-reqid-test -> staging started by liz at 2026-03-23T15:12:40Z :rocket:

kevin: Nice. Once CI is green let's backport the fix to the 1.5.x branch (onboarding images use that).

mika: Also propose a tiny doc note in the onboarding guide: "If you see missing request IDs in local runs, ensure SDK init order places request-id attachment before user-introduced shims or use the transport-layer flag."

liz: Will add doc blurb and ping eng-docs for a short blurb in the quickstart. PR up in a bit, ping me for review. :thumbsup:
